_comment: Land search 2026-10-15: Khalni Heart Expedition holds ONE quest counter. Playing the Forest (counter 2) and
casting Rampant Growth (counter 3) fill it MID-PLAN; the crack ('remove three quest counters and sacrifice it:
two basics onto the battlefield tapped', PermAbilityMode::QuestSacLandSearch) is then reachable in the SAME
main phase only through breakpoint site 9 (its out-of-band activation key, kActQuestLandSearch) -- activations
are enumerated against the plan-START board. Avenger of Zendikar and three 0/1 Plants can attack: four
landfalls make each Plant 4/5 -> 5 + 12 = 17 = the opponent's life; without the crack it is 5 + 6 = 11.
